name: Jari Mäkinen
bio:
Jari's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Initially trained as a carpenter, he discovered a passion for composite materials while working on a boat restoration project. Intrigued by their strength and lightweight properties, he sought opportunities to apply his skills in racing. He started in a local rally team, repairing bodywork and fabricating custom aerodynamic parts. Over the years, he honed his expertise in carbon fiber layup, vacuum bagging, and resin infusion, becoming proficient in creating complex composite structures.

At Garage 59, Jari is known for his meticulous attention to detail and unwavering commitment to quality. He approaches each project with a craftsman's precision, ensuring that every component meets the highest standards of performance and durability. While not the most outgoing member of the team, his expertise in composite materials and his dedication to his craft make him an invaluable asset. He can always be relied on to get the job done, and done right, regardless of the challenges involved.

physical.description: Jari is a stocky man with a serious demeanor.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to a perfect point before starting any task.
Has a particular aversion to improperly mixed resin.
Listens to Finnish folk music through noise-cancelling headphones while working.
